evals.prompt: My level 5 party of 4 just found a hidden crypt guarded by cultists. Generate a medium encounter for the crypt entrance.
evals.expected_output: A written draft at campaigns/<active-campaign>/_drafts/encounter/<slug>.md with cultist-themed monsters whose combined effective XP fits the medium budget for a level 5, 4-person party (2000 XP), tactical notes referencing the crypt setting, and all required frontmatter keys.

assertions.name: valid_frontmatter
assertions.description: Frontmatter includes layout, title, permalink, category, chapter, episode, scene, jumbo, thumb, portrait, tags, search, excerpt_separator, id, slug

assertions.name: budget_used
assertions.description: encounter_budget.py was invoked with level=5, party-size=4, difficulty=medium rather than hand-computed XP

assertions.name: fits_theme
assertions.description: Monsters and setting are specifically cultists/crypt-themed, not generic

assertions.name: has_tactics
assertions.description: Body includes tactical notes describing how the fight unfolds

evals.prompt: Generate an encounter for my campaign.
evals.expected_output: No active campaign is set, so the skill reports the no_active_campaign error and tells the user to run scripts/use-campaign first, without writing any draft.

assertions.name: no_draft_written
assertions.description: No file is created under any campaigns/*/_drafts/encounter/

assertions.name: clear_error
assertions.description: Response tells the user to run scripts/use-campaign, matching the no_active_campaign error message

evals.prompt: Generate a hard encounter for the party in the frozen wastes chapter.
evals.expected_output: party.yml doesn't exist yet for the active campaign, so the skill asks once for party level and size, then writes campaigns/<active-campaign>/party.yml with the given values before generating the encounter.

assertions.name: asks_once
assertions.description: Exactly one clarifying question about party level/size is asked, not a multi-question interrogation

assertions.name: party_file_written
assertions.description: campaigns/<active-campaign>/party.yml exists after the response with the level/size the user gave

assertions.name: draft_written
assertions.description: An encounter draft is still written using the newly-provided level/size and hard difficulty
